s: THE 3D SCENE — the transversal whole: the six product discs distributed through z (+0.34 to −0.42) while the envelope sequences the six names verbatim (Central → Actuation → AIKit → Software Factory → Workcell → Quaternal Logic, AC §3's own disclosures of the means); depth means the whole the six belong to — S is not a seventh product but the field in which they hold together; depthPerspective+occlusion+tint authored.

s0–s5: each product's centre square sequences its WHOLE ASSIGNED PAIR's two movements, verbatim from the record's own §1/§2 lens-section titles (L0×L5′, L1×L4′, L2×L3′, L3×L2′, L4×L1′, L5×L0′) — both lens bodies carried as staged moves, not labels; second lens accent deeper (the pair completes).

Pointers carry product character: s vortex (the whole turns), s0 attract gentle (continuity keeps), s1 attract/shove (an act takes position), s2 attract/pulse + potency breathe (capability available), s3 vortex/vortex + transform pulse (the factory's traffic), s4 repel (material resistance answers), s5 vortex/vortex (transcendent relation).

s0 lens2 (L5′) and s3 lens1 (L3) bodies compressed to ≤70 words — no claim changed ('what has been disclosed' → 'the disclosure', 'the entry of possible form into' → 'possible form entering'); lens columns narrowed (w 160, second column x 0.55) so the pair reads as two plates at 390×844 without overlap; kickers byte-exact (S0 · ARGUED · M37 …).
Beats: durations 13–15s, transitions 1.8–2.6; 3 automation lanes; ring layout on s, grid on s4, Single formation on the pairs.
This journey stays the essay's §5 staging; the full-depth 83-member product field is a different lane (LANE-S-PRODUCTS.md).

Craft rework 2026-10-07 (expression rework pass, lane 5; records re-read at fc59a719). The product field is drawn: the whole is a World ring holding a Life centre and six offices, each wearing its product's accent (gold Central, ember Actuation, teal AIKit, rust Factory, moss Workcell, violet Quaternal), with the offices named in order around the ring; each product scene then draws its whole assigned MEF pair as two glasses and the bond between them, with the pair's two lens lines walking verbatim between the glasses — the lens bodies come off the stage and live in the binding and the field's connections panel, where the full-depth record already holds them. S5 draws its own quaternal figure (square with two counter-turned triangles — no yantra) as its office. The workshop moves through iron dusk (shared by the whole and Central — the journey's first held pair), blue steel, graphite, forge (shared by Factory and Workcell — the second held pair) and violet night. Pointers keep the product character (the whole turns, Central keeps, Actuation and AIKit gather, the Factory pulses, S5 drifts transcendent). Stage text is seven hospitable sign-names and one opening line (13 words); every kicker, route and lens body is off the stage.
